title: Verifiable Multi-Paper Literature Knowledge Graph Schema
description: Domain-agnostic, provenance-bound scientific literature knowledge graph ontology with two-tier entity alignment (Concept vs ScopedInstance), explicit non-merge/conflict tracking, and incremental update guarantees.
epistemic_rules: Every substantive node mention and every edge evidence item MUST bind (source_id, paragraph_id, locator_type, quote) verifiable against the exact paragraph text in corpus_index.json.
When has_pdf_pages is false, locator_type MUST NOT be pdf_page and no synthetic page 1 may be claimed as an original PDF page.
Root case.json DOI/title/authors belong ONLY to the primary paper and MUST NOT be applied to secondary papers.
Multiple file formats (e.g. JSON + Markdown) of the same paper share one paper_group_id and NEVER count as cross-paper evidence.
Edges with attribution in {cited_prior_work, speculation_or_hypothesis} MUST NOT be assigned evidence_strength == strong_direct.

Sharing a generic material/method/task term across papers does NOT imply identical physical samples, model instances, datasets, or experimental conditions; keep distinct instances separate via keep_separate_distinct_instance and optionally link via INSTANTIATES_CONCEPT to an abstract Concept node.
Never collapse experimental conditions, samples, or numeric metrics from two different papers into a single non-comparative edge or single blended conclusion.

Missing modalities (figure pixels, supplementary attachments, raw clinical/experimental tables) MUST be explicitly recorded in declared_input_boundaries and uncertainty; never fabricate unseen values.

properties.id: Stable deterministic ID: E001, E002, ... (or C001, ... for cross-paper abstract Concept nodes). Preserved across incremental updates.
properties.canonical_name: Paper-grounded canonical surface name (for ScopedInstance nodes include source qualifier if needed to prevent ambiguity).
properties.source_ids: Sorted list of unique source_ids where this node is grounded.
properties.aliases: Sorted list of exact surface forms/abbreviations/case variants observed in the papers.
properties.attributes: Optional paper-grounded attributes (e.g. sample composition, sample size, version, units, formula_xml_verified). Never blend attributes across papers.

mentions.paragraph_id: Exact JATS paragraph_id or locator ID from corpus_index.json
mentions.surface_form: Exact entity text as written in that paragraph
mentions.quote: Short verbatim excerpt from that paragraph containing or supporting the entity
mentions.xml_verified_formula: Optional exact formula/subscript string reconciled from publisher XML

properties.id: Stable deterministic ID: R001, R002, ... Preserved across incremental updates.
properties.source: Source node ID (must exist in nodes[]).
properties.target: Target node ID (must exist in nodes[]).
properties.conditions: Applicable experimental/clinical/computational conditions, sample/dataset scope, baseline/control, numeric value with units, or explicit 'not_reported_in_source'.

evidence.paragraph_id: Exact JATS paragraph_id or locator ID
evidence.quote: Short verbatim excerpt directly supporting the relation and direction

properties.is_cross_paper: Boolean; true ONLY when evidence spans >=2 distinct paper_group_id values (never same-paper multi-format).

candidate_a.node_id_or_name: Primary/existing node ID or surface name

candidate_b.node_id_or_name: Secondary/new entity temp_id or surface name

properties.canonical_target_id: Target existing node_id when merge_alias; null otherwise
properties.shared_concept_name: Optional abstract Concept name when verdict == keep_separate_distinct_instance (creates Concept node + INSTANTIATES_CONCEPT edges without merging instances)
properties.rationale: Explicit scientific and textual justification for merging or refusing to merge (e.g. distinct physical sample, different experimental condition, homonym abbreviation, or explicit acronym definition).
